purpose: Executable ledger for the `singularity-censorship-hyperbolicity` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Singularity-resolution rows cap geodesic-completeness, curvature blow-up, bounce, endpoint, and extension language; sector-local resolution is not ToE closure.

singularity_rows.singularity_object: Geodesic incompleteness, curvature blow-up, trapped-surface, big-bang/bounce, black-hole interior, Cauchy-horizon, effective-endpoint, or metadata-only singularity claim made by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
singularity_rows.resolution_mechanism: Declare whether the route removes curvature blow-up, extends geodesics, replaces the singular region by a bounce, uses stringy/dual variables, uses RG improvement, uses causal discreteness, uses boundary/code reconstruction, uses effective equations, or only changes the description. Coordinate regularity or finite proxy variables are not enough.
singularity_rows.geodesic_or_invariant_gap: State which invariant, geodesic family, extension class, energy condition, trapped-surface hypothesis, quantum-state condition, or public record shows resolution. If only some curves, sectors, symmetry reductions, or idealized models are handled, the row remains local.
singularity_rows.residual_singularity_or_endpoint: Name residual null/timelike/spacelike incompleteness, weak/strong singularity, Cauchy horizon, bounce instability, remnant, baby-universe, endpoint, topology/signature change, or boundary-condition dependence.
singularity_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer full singularity resolution, black-hole information closure, cosmological beginning solved, or ToE identification from a sector-local singularity row.
